title: Unraveling structural transitions and kinetics along the fold-switching pathway of the RfaH C-terminal domain using exchange-based NMR.
authors: Cai, Mengli; Ying, Jinfa; Lopez, Juan M; Huang, Ying; Clore, G Marius
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
one_liner_zh: 该文用NMR研究转录调控因子RfaH C端结构域的折叠转换动力学，虽涉及转录因子但无DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，仅实验表征，与课题关联较弱。
abstract: The bacterial transcriptional regulator RfaH comprises structurally and functionally distinct N- (NTD) and C- (CTD) terminal domains. The latter switches from a helical hairpin packed against the NTD to a five-stranded beta-roll upon displacement by RNA polymerase binding. Here, we use exchange-based NMR to probe fold-switching intermediates sampled by the isolated CTD. In addition to the predominant (~76 to 77%), semistable beta-roll conformation (state A), we identify four structurally and kinetically distinct states: A', B, B', and B''. State B is NMR observable with an occupancy of ~23%, exchanges slowly (tau(ex) ~ 300 ms) with the major A species, and comprises a largely unfolded ensemble with transient occupancy of helical (alpha5*) and beta-hairpin (beta1*/beta2*) elements. Backbone chemical shift-based structure predictions using the program CS-ROSETTA suggest that the two transient structural elements within the B state may interact with one another to form a semicompact structure. A' (~0.35%) is an off-pathway state that exchanges rapidly (tau(ex) ~ 1 ms) with state A and likely entails a minor localized conformational change in the beta1/beta2 loop. State B' (~0.3%) exchanges rapidly (tau(ex) ~ 1.2 ms) with state B and exhibits downfield (15)N backbone shifts (relative to B) in the alpha5* region indicative of reduced helicity. Finally state B'' (~0.05%) exchanges rapidly (tau(ex) ~ 0.8 to 1 ms) with either B' (linear model) or B (branched model), displays significant differences in absolute (15)N chemical shift from states B and B', and likely represents a further intermediate with increased helicity along the fold-switching pathway.
abstract_zh: 细菌转录调控因子RfaH包含结构和功能上不同的N端（NTD）和C端（CTD）结构域。后者在RNA聚合酶结合置换后，从与NTD紧密堆积的螺旋发夹结构转变为五链β-卷曲结构。在此，我们利用基于交换的核磁共振（NMR）探测分离的CTD所采样的折叠转换中间态。除了主要的（约76%至77%）半稳定β-卷曲构象（状态A）外，我们识别出四个结构和动力学上不同的状态：A'、B、B'和B''。状态B在NMR中可观测，占据率约23%，与主要A物种缓慢交换（tau(ex) ~ 300 ms），并包含一个大部分未折叠的集合体，其中瞬时占据螺旋（alpha5*）和β-发夹（beta1*/beta2*）元件。基于主链化学位移的结构预测程序CS-ROSETTA表明，B状态中的两个瞬时结构元件可能相互作用形成半紧凑结构。A'（约0.35%）是一个偏离路径的状态，与状态A快速交换（tau(ex) ~ 1 ms），可能涉及beta1/beta2环中的微小局部构象变化。状态B'（约0.3%）与状态B快速交换（tau(ex) ~ 1.2 ms），并在alpha5*区域表现出相对于B的下场(15)N主链位移，表明螺旋性降低。最后，状态B''（约0.05%）与B'（线性模型）或B（分支模型）快速交换（tau(ex) ~ 0.8至1 ms），在绝对(15)N化学位移上与状态B和B'显示显著差异，可能代表折叠转换路径上螺旋性增加的进一步中间态。
